planted.note: a repo with 3 passing tests and a baseline of 3. Planted defect 1: one test file is deleted (3 -> 2 tests) and the gate must FAIL on the ratchet. Planted defect 2: a failing test is added and the gate must FAIL on the test.

clean.note: the same repo with 3 tests passes, and with a new test added (4 tests) it passes again and the baseline rises to 4.
